intro.h2: Cabinets that fit, down to the eighth of an inch
paragraphs: Herrera's makes custom cabinets McGregor families use in nearly every room: kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms, pantries and living room built-ins. Each one is built for the space it goes into, which is the whole point of going custom.

One customer had Herrera's build for her kitchen, living room, bathrooms and laundry room, and wrote that everything fit perfectly, adding that one eighth of an inch off and drawers won't open. When another contractor messed things up, Herrera's adapted. More than two years later she says the painted cabinets are holding up and the stained and varnished ones still look brand new.

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Full kitchens and big islands, from deep charcoal shaker cabinets with brass cup pulls to soft sage green runs. Doors, drawers and panels are built to your layout so appliances, sinks and range hoods drop in where they belong.

image.alt: Sage green shaker kitchen cabinets with gold pulls, grey countertops and stainless range

items.name: Bathroom vanities
items.blurb: Vanities sized to your bathroom, with drawer stacks and door cabinets where you need storage. One family had Herrera's build for all of their bathrooms, and the white painted vanity in their photos still looks crisp more than two years on.

image.alt: White painted bathroom vanity with drawers, brass pulls and dark grey countertop

items.name: Pantries and laundry rooms
items.blurb: Butler's pantries with glass-front uppers, tall storage and long runs of drawers, plus laundry room cabinets that make a small space work harder. These are the rooms where an exact fit pays off every single day.

image.alt: Galley pantry with white shaker cabinets, glass-front uppers, granite counter and patterned tile backsplash

items.name: Built-ins and bookcases
items.blurb: Entertainment walls around a fireplace, bookcases, and drawers tucked under a staircase. One reviewer calls Herrera's the best for custom cabinets and woodwork, and the built-ins in these photos show the range, from stained wood to deep painted finishes.

image.alt: Stained wood built-in bookcases and TV wall around a stone fireplace in a living room

items.name: Painted and stained finishes
items.blurb: Choose a painted color or a stain with varnish. A customer who has lived with both for over two years says the painted surfaces are holding up great and the stained and varnished surfaces still look brand new.

image.alt: Cream painted kitchen island cabinets with raised panel doors and black pulls

items.title: A precise fit
items.text: Reviewers say the cabinets fit into every space perfectly. As one put it, one eighth of an inch off and drawers won't open, so that precision matters.

items.title: Finishes that last
items.text: Painted cabinets holding up great, stained and varnished cabinets looking brand new: that is how one customer described her cabinets more than two years after install.

items.title: Able to adapt
items.text: When another contractor on the job messed things up, Herrera's was able to adapt and keep the project moving. Reviewers also describe the team as willing to work with you.

items.title: Every room, one maker
items.text: Kitchen, bathrooms, laundry room, pantry and living room built-ins can all come from the same cabinet maker, so the doors, finishes and quality match from room to room.

about.text: Herrera Custom Cabinets, known on Facebook as Herrera's Cabinets, is a cabinet maker at 379 Val Verde Rd in McGregor, Texas. The work goes well past kitchens. Customers have had Herrera's build for their kitchens, living rooms, bathrooms and laundry rooms, and one reviewer calls them the best for custom cabinets and woodwork. Herrera's also built cabinets for an Operation Finally Home project, a home that was praised as a beautiful job. The shop is open weekdays, so you can call and talk through what you have in mind for your own home.

image.alt: Built-in bookcase painted dark green with natural wood shelves and lower cabinet doors

process.h2: How a custom cabinet project works

steps.title: Call and talk it over
steps.text: Phone (254) 709-5497 on a weekday between 8 AM and 6 PM and tell us which rooms you want cabinets for.

steps.title: Measurements
steps.text: We visit, take careful measurements and go over what you want, from door style to finish and storage needs.

steps.title: Drawing and quote
steps.text: You get a drawing and a written price for your cabinets, so you can review options and add-ons before anything is built.

steps.title: Build, finish and install
steps.text: Your cabinets are built, painted or stained and varnished, then installed to fit the space exactly.

service_area.text: Herrera Custom Cabinets is based at 379 Val Verde Rd in McGregor, Texas, and McGregor is the town named on its Google and Facebook pages. If you are planning a new kitchen, a bathroom update or built-ins for a home nearby and want to know whether Herrera's can take it on, call (254) 709-5497 on a weekday and ask about your location.

items.q: Which rooms do you build cabinets for?
items.a: Just about any room. Customers have had Herrera's build cabinets for kitchens, living rooms, bathrooms and laundry rooms, and the photos here also show a butler's pantry, bookcases, a fireplace wall and drawers built under a staircase. If it needs storage, ask us.

items.q: Painted or stained: which holds up better?
items.a: Both can last. One customer with painted and stained cabinets says that more than two years later the painted surfaces are holding up great and the stained and varnished surfaces still look brand new. We can talk through which suits your room and how you use it.

items.q: Can you work around problems left by another contractor?
items.a: Often, yes. One reviewer wrote that another contractor on her project really messed things up and Herrera's was able to adapt. Every job is different, so call and describe the situation, and we will tell you honestly what we can do.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call (254) 709-5497. We will come out, take measurements and talk through what you want. After that you receive a drawing and a price for your cabinets, including any add-ons you asked about, so you can make changes before the build starts.

items.q: What are your hours and where are you?
items.a: Herrera Custom Cabinets is at 379 Val Verde Rd, McGregor, TX 76657. We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Calling ahead is the best way to make sure someone is available to talk.

final_cta.h2: Let's build cabinets that fit your home
final_cta.text: Call Herrera's to talk about your kitchen, bathroom, laundry room or built-ins.
